How should Quote Price Estimate work in Chemceed?

In Chemceed, Quote Price Estimate is a custom report/tool that pulls from Quote, Product, and Sourcing data. It was extended so that if a sourcing is copied from a quote, the estimate can still pull from the copied sourcing. If the estimate looks wrong, check the quote-to-sourcing linkage and the custom calculations before assuming default VISCO estimate behavior.

Why is the Quote Price Estimate loading blank?

For Chemceed, a blank Quote Price Estimate can happen if the quote is not tied correctly to sourcing in the custom linkage logic. Chemceed added a hidden Copied From Quote field on sourcing to support this behavior. Verify that the sourcing was copied from the quote and that the estimate is pulling from the intended linked sourcing record.

If values look wrong, review both the custom formulas and the expected Chemceed precision rules, such as additional decimal places for quantity and price-related outputs.

It may depend on a sourcing copied from the quote, so the relationship between quote and sourcing is part of the intended Chemceed design.
